context: Mathematics / Precalculus. No authored doc.md exists for this course; each lesson is grounded in its live topic list and its existing quiz bank (source.md).

laterLessonsCover: 02 Trigonometry: Special trig values and identities on the unit circle, Angle addition identities, Inverse trigonometric functions, Laws of sines and cosines, Sinusoidal equations and models

03 Complex numbers: The complex plane (Distance, Midpoint, Conjugates), Modulus and argument, Polar form of complex numbers, Multiplying/Dividing complex numbers in polar form, The Fundamental Theorem of Algebra
04 Rational functions: Advanced rational expression arithmetic, End behavior and discontinuities (Asymptotes), Graphs of rational functions
05 Conic sections: Introduction to ellipses and hyperbolas, Foci, vertices, and equations of conics
06 Vectors: Vector components, magnitude, and direction, Scalar multiplication, addition, and subtraction, Vector word problems

07 Matrices: Matrix arithmetic (Addition, Subtraction, Scalar Multiplication), Matrix multiplication and properties, Inverses and solving systems with matrices, Matrices as transformations of the plane
08 Probability and combinatorics: Venn diagrams and addition/multiplication rules, Permutations and combinations, Discrete random variables and Expected Value
09 Series: Summation notation, Arithmetic and Geometric series, The Binomial Theorem
10 Limits and continuity: Defining and estimating limits (Graphs and Tables), Limit properties and algebraic manipulation, Continuity and the Intermediate Value Theorem
